name: EventMon
tagline: Windows 11 Event Viewer, Unified Log & Diagnostic Suite
short_description: Native macOS event exploration with Low Effort Suite v2.0 cross-app theme and persistent Dock icon sync, optional rounded desktop Cards, a visual widget gallery, eight event graph styles, scoped buffered-event summaries, event inspectors and correlation maps.
spotlight_description: EventMon v2.0 standardizes the Low Effort Suite across PerfMon, EventMon, VolMon, and WebMon with cross-app theme, accent, and persistent Dock icon synchronization, alongside the six-preview widget gallery, optional Cards presentation, and eight buffered event graph styles.
